hooks.command: code_changes=$(git status --short 2>/dev/null | grep -Ev '\.md$|^\?\?' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); log_ok=$(git status --short 2>/dev/null | grep 'AI_TASK_LOG' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$code_changes" -gt 0 ] && [ "$log_ok" -eq 0 ]; then printf '{"systemMessage":"\u26a0 Task log reminder: code files were changed but AI_TASK_LOG.md has not been updated. Update it and include it in the same commit."}'; fi
